rules.rationale: The A13 build repository is a superproject. Init build establishes its child layout and 04a5a80 advances make and soong gitlinks. Android 16 tracks build/make and build/soong directly, so replaying the superproject objects would be incorrect; every child patch is enumerated separately from the recorded pre-update child SHAs through the child bst-v5.22.210 heads.
rules.necessity: The topology is necessary provenance but has no independent target runtime behavior.
rules.performance: No runtime or build-time cost; this decision prevents double replay of child changes.
rules.security: No superproject object is treated as proof that child content is present; child source patches retain independent review decisions.
validation_evidence: A13 build commit 04a5a80 records make a9966132 to 47f341a7 and soong 34839fc9 to 60366476; the audit continues through current child heads fa3b06f0 and e5cbcf04.

rules.rationale: The two calendar commits are an add-then-replace sequence whose final A13 state selects DeskClock. Android 16 preserves that final state and the removal of Browser2, Calendar, Music, QuickSearchBox, BasicDreams, BluetoothMidiService, BuiltInPrintService, ManagedProvisioning, MmsService, HTMLViewer and EmergencyInfo.
rules.necessity: Required to retain the BlueStacks guest package surface and avoid duplicate or unsupported system applications.
rules.performance: Reduces image size, package scanning and background services; no hot-path overhead.
rules.security: Reduces the preinstalled application surface. CalendarProvider remains because other applications may depend on its provider contract.
validation_evidence: Target commit 6483acb67e removes the final A13 package set at the Android 16 product files and retains DeskClock.

rules.rationale: A13 made vndservice and vndservicemanager unconditional globally. Android 16 keeps upstream shipping-API policy and selects vndservicemanager only for the Windows android_x86_64 product; its dependency installs vndservice. This preserves the required guest behavior without changing every A16 product.
rules.necessity: Required by legacy vendor Binder services used by the BlueStacks Windows guest.
rules.performance: Starts one required service-manager process only on the target product.
rules.security: Narrower than A13: the legacy vendor service manager is not added to unrelated Android 16 products.
validation_evidence: Built installed-files.txt contains /system/vendor/bin/vndservice, /system/vendor/bin/vndservicemanager and its init rc.

rules.rationale: A13 added libwvdrmengine to the global vendor package list. The Android 16 Windows product obtains the current Houdini/Widevine module through its product integration rather than changing the platform-wide base_vendor list.
rules.necessity: Required for guest Widevine DRM compatibility.
rules.performance: Adds one shared library to the image; no cost until a DRM client loads it.
rules.security: The binary is external proprietary input and must be identity-pinned and runtime-tested; it is not copied into the documentation repository.
validation_evidence: Built installed-files.txt records /system/vendor/lib/libwvdrmengine.so and the output file exists at 1,250,188 bytes. Runtime DRM playback remains in the final boot gate.

rules.rationale: Android 16 sets PRODUCT_ART_TARGET_INCLUDE_DEBUG_BUILD=false in android_x86_64.mk, preserving A13 release ART behavior for eng images while leaving other products at upstream defaults.
rules.necessity: Required for application compatibility and production-equivalent ART behavior in the Windows image pipeline.
rules.performance: Uses the release ART APEX, avoiding debug overhead and reducing image/runtime cost.
rules.security: Avoids shipping debug ART behavior in the product guest.
validation_evidence: The target product assignment and current runtime_libart selection path were inspected together.

rules.rationale: A13 bypassed eng and prebuilt dexpreopt restrictions when BST_BUILD_WITH_DEXPREOPT=true. Android 16 implements the same final intent at the current OVERRIDE_DISABLE_DEXOPT_ALL gate.
rules.necessity: Required for production package startup performance from the eng image pipeline.
rules.performance: Increases build time and image size in exchange for lower first-run compilation and launch latency.
rules.security: Does not change code trust; generated oat/vdex artifacts remain bound to the built APK/JAR inputs.
validation_evidence: Target commit 90781461 is present and incremental Java builds completed with the Android 16 product configuration.

rules.rationale: A13 hard-coded 240 into every generated partition build.prop. Android 16 applies the host-provided DPI in device/generic/common init.sh, preserving the Windows product contract without globally mutating all partitions/products.
rules.necessity: Required for host-controlled display density and launcher/layout compatibility.
rules.performance: One boot-time property assignment; no rendering-loop overhead.
rules.security: The host value must remain validated because extreme density values can make UI inaccessible.
validation_evidence: Target init.sh calls set_property ro.sf.lcd_density with the resolved DPI.

rules.rationale: These A13 commits add and rotate private product signing material inside build/make. Android 16 intentionally does not import historical private keys into source control; signing identity is an external release-pipeline input.
rules.necessity: The signing identity may be necessary for upgrade compatibility, but the secret files themselves are neither a source patch nor safe repository content.
rules.security: Private keys must be rotated and injected from controlled secret storage. Only public identity/hash provenance belongs in project documentation.
validation_evidence: Android 16 build/make tracks no bluestacks-market key files. Final release signing identity requires a separate secure gate.

rules.rationale: A13 relaxed core/binary.mk path handling globally to build out-of-tree modules. Android 16 discovers only the explicit BlueStacks Android.mk files through Soong and retains platform path validation; restoring the broad Make relaxation would increase drift and hide bad include paths.
rules.necessity: The broad relaxation is unnecessary because all required external modules are explicitly discovered and current target builds pass.
rules.performance: Retaining strict path checks has no runtime cost and avoids ambiguous incremental dependencies.
rules.security: Strict source/output boundaries reduce accidental reads from arbitrary host paths during builds.
validation_evidence: Current Soong finder lists hd and gated goldfish Android.mk inputs; build/make commit 2872af3a restores strict outside-include errors.

rules.rationale: The duplicate A13 changes disabled ELF validation for every PRODUCT_COPY_FILES entry. Android 16 retains the upstream default and uses product-specific fixes for incompatible prebuilts.
rules.necessity: Not necessary for the current build and too broad for mainline promotion.
rules.performance: Adds build-time validation only; no guest runtime cost.
rules.security: Retaining ELF validation catches ABI, partition and dependency mistakes before image publication.
validation_evidence: Current core/Makefile initializes check_elf_prebuilt_product_copy_files to true and target builds pass.

rules.rationale: Android 16 preserves every final A13 hd module path, including bstchkdata, and gates goldfish-opengl-pie discovery on BST_BUILD_EXTERNAL_GOLDFISH. Later A16 commits add only explicitly required settings and FFmpeg paths.
rules.necessity: Required to link app-player guest modules while keeping the android_x86_64 target build self-identifying.
rules.performance: Adds a fixed small list to finder output; no recursive external-tree scan and no guest runtime cost.
rules.security: Only named Android.mk files are admitted, and external goldfish input requires an explicit environment gate.
validation_evidence: Current ui/build/finder.go contains vmsg, xpl, bstconf, bstchkdata, hcall, gcall and gated goldfish entries.

rules.rationale: A13 disabled the source-root cwd check and Kati --werror_writable globally. Android 16 external modules are integrated through finder paths, so these broad diagnostics remain enabled.
rules.necessity: Not necessary; all focused target builds pass with --werror_writable.
rules.performance: Build-only validation with negligible runtime; retaining it improves deterministic incremental builds.
rules.security: Prevents builds from silently writing source/read-only locations or running from an unintended tree.
validation_evidence: Current ui/build/kati.go passes --werror_writable and current config.go retains source-root validation.

rules.rationale: A13 globally allowlisted host perl for an older build dependency. The Android 16 target build does not require that exception, so it is not promoted.
rules.necessity: Not necessary for current source or packaging workflows.
rules.performance: No guest impact; avoiding unused host tools reduces build-environment variability.
rules.security: Keeps the path interposer allowlist minimal and avoids admitting arbitrary host perl scripts into hermetic builds.
validation_evidence: Current ui/build/paths/config.go does not allowlist perl and focused Android 16 builds complete successfully.
